other_text:
IS THIS CREATURE REAL?
CREATURE SIGHTINGS IN COLDBROOK!
ATTENTION PLEASE STAY OUT OF THE WOODS
TOWN CURFEW AT 9:00PM UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE
THE COLDBROOK TIMES
BOOK AN AD!
On May 10th, residents of Coldbrook reported seeing a strange creature in the woods. Some say they have seen it more than once. A local school bell rings at dusk to signal when the streets are safe to travel. A curfew has been imposed. The creature is said to attack anyone who defies the rules.
description: A vintage-style poster advertises a movie titled 'Curfew,' featuring a shadowy creature and urgent warnings about staying out of the woods after dark.
